## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.3-1

### SBS50 Local MQTT
- Adds an options flow for configuring the SBS50's native MQTT publishing with a local broker.
- Keeps existing cloud entities and camera connections separate. Initial configuration requires cloud access; native publishing depends on supported base-station firmware and devices.
- Does not save broker passwords in the integration's configuration entry.

### Device Settings and Actions
- Uses the STH0C server settings API for temperature and humidity ranges, calibration and display units, preserving companion settings and pending-update information.
- Aligns STH0C calibration limits and humidity adjustment precision with the app.
- Adds SWS0B low-temperature detection settings on supported firmware and XR0A-iR radon warning enable, threshold and monitoring-period controls.
- Adds CO peak reset for XC04-WX and SBS50-connected XC01-M detectors, plus a temporary SMS01 motion walk-test control with automatic timeout and cleanup.
- Updates combination-detector mute commands for their model and firmware routes, and uses the app account code for device commands with a legacy-account fallback.
- Pairs alarm enable and volume updates for STH51, STH0A and STH0B, and exposes all seven alarm tones for supported mailbox and driveway sensors.

### Entity Discovery and State
- Adds late discovery of security alarm panels without requiring cameras or an integration reload.
- Aligns regional combination-detector aliases with their alarm, silence, end-of-life and standalone shadow routes.
- Accepts bracketed temperature and humidity range values and rejects invalid non-finite readings and settings.

### Connection and Playback Reliability
- Validates credential-refresh responses before replacing working credentials, distinguishing expired sessions from temporary service errors.
- Handles malformed MQTT envelopes and failed shadow responses without silently accepting invalid data.
- Adds bounded recording-proxy downloads, timeouts and concurrency limits without changing audio or live-view signaling.
- Strengthens synchronous client request handling and removes authentication details from diagnostic stream URLs.

### Translations
- Adds localized names for the new controls in all supported integration languages.
